view.scene_description: A wide-angle view of a large warehouse interior with high ceilings and fluorescent lighting. Red metal shelving units line both sides, stocked with boxes and pallets. Yellow safety barriers and aisle markers are present. The floor is concrete, and various industrial items like crates and wrapped goods are scattered throughout. The perspective suggests a fisheye lens effect.

objects.label: red metal shelving unit
objects.observation: Tall red metal shelving unit on the right side of the frame, filled with boxes and wrapped materials. Has yellow identification tags reading 'AA 09' and 'AA 08'. Supported by legs, partially obstructed by yellow safety barriers at its base. Adjacent to other similar racks extending into the background.

objects.label: yellow safety barrier
objects.observation: Yellow plastic safety barrier positioned at the base of the red shelving unit on the right. Appears freestanding, resting directly on the concrete floor. Partially obscures lower shelves and provides a visual separation between aisles.

objects.label: blue vertical sign
objects.observation: Blue vertical sign mounted on a black post near the left edge of the frame. Contains white text 'BA 14'. Positioned next to stacked cardboard boxes and wooden pallets. Appears to be affixed to the post, indicating an aisle or section identifier.

objects.label: cardboard boxes
objects.observation: Multiple cardboard boxes stacked on wooden pallets along the left side of the aisle. Some are open, others sealed. Located beneath the blue sign and near the base of tall metal racks. Resting directly on the concrete floor and pallets, forming part of inventory storage.

objects.label: wooden pallet
objects.observation: Wooden pallets placed on the floor, some holding boxes, others empty. Located in the foreground on the left and mid-ground on the right. Resting directly on the concrete floor. Used for transporting and storing goods within the warehouse.

objects.label: fluorescent light fixture
objects.observation: Long rectangular fluorescent light fixtures suspended from the ceiling. Multiple fixtures evenly spaced across the top of the frame. Illuminating the entire warehouse space. Mounted to the ceiling via visible brackets, providing overhead lighting.

objects.label: metal rack system
objects.observation: High metal racks on the left side, partially obscured by the blue sign. Constructed of steel with multiple levels. Contains various items including boxes and containers. Integrated into the warehouse structure, supporting inventory storage.

objects.label: plastic-wrapped goods
objects.observation: Large bundles of goods wrapped in clear plastic, stored on the red shelving unit on the right. Located on upper shelves near the 'AA 09' label. Resting on metal shelves, secured by straps or bands. Part of warehouse inventory.
